items.title: Why Regeneron (REGN) Is Up 5.4% After FDA Approves Pasatru For Ultra-Rare FOP Therapy

This approval adds a rare-disease monoclonal antibody to Regeneron’s portfolio, reinforcing the company’s focus on specialized, high-complexity immunology therapies.
